name: Product usage
description: Setup, cleaning, accessories, compatibility, and routine X100 usage questions.
promptSnippet: Use product FAQ and answer with support steps.

name: Troubleshooting
description: Fault codes, cannot-start, abnormal display, abnormal noise, and network pairing failures.

name: Fault-code lookup
description: Lookup X100 fault codes such as E01, E17, E37, and N04.
promptSnippet: Explain likely causes, customer checks, support-agent checks, escalation conditions, and basis.

name: Cannot-start flow
description: X100 cannot power on, no indicator, or startup loop.

name: Warranty
description: Warranty coverage, exclusions, proof, and warranty-status checks.
promptSnippet: Use warranty policy and identify missing proof.

name: Warranty status lookup
description: Check warranty status by serial number.
promptSnippet: Use tool result as warranty basis and combine with policy when needed.

name: Return and exchange
description: Return window, exchange window, inspection flow, and non-returnable cases.
promptSnippet: Use return policy and ask for purchase or delivery date when missing.

name: Service center
description: Find repair locations and explain appointment rules.
promptSnippet: Use city and product model to find an authorized service center.

name: Ticket status
description: Check after-sales ticket status and next action by ticket ID.
promptSnippet: Use ticket status tool and state next support action.

name: Product lookup
description: Look up product model and purchase metadata by serial number.
promptSnippet: Use product lookup tool before warranty or repair advice when model is missing.

name: Escalation
description: Safety, legal, payment, privacy, severe product failure, or repeated repair escalation.
promptSnippet: Recommend immediate escalation and avoid risky customer instructions.
